summary: src/v2/runtime/work-cost.js:82 将连续 HUMAN_REQUESTED 合并为一段等待，违反 work.md 每次请求单独计段的要求：第 0、5 分钟请求、第 10 分钟决定时，实际得到 humanWaits=2、decided.count=1、时长 10 分钟，应为 2 段共 15 分钟；tests/v2-replay-followups.test.js:120–123 也错误地固化了合并口径。

note: owner decision 2026-10-07: a request repeated before any decision continues the same wait, counted once from the first request; counting each request as its own segment would count the overlapping time twice. In 216 real runs, 16 had such repeats (26 times), all re-requests of the same pending decision after a resume.
